improvements.zh: 参考图片单次可选择最多16张。
improvements.en: Select up to 16 reference images per request.

fixes.zh: 优化参考图编辑的兼容性。
不支持的画幅会在开始生成前提示，减少无效等待。
fixes.en: Unsupported aspect ratios are reported before submission to avoid unnecessary waiting.

fixes.zh: 区分服务暂时不可用与并发繁忙提示。
fixes.en: Distinguished temporary service unavailability from capacity limits.

improvements.zh: 文字、图片和视频的创作工具栏采用统一布局。
improvements.en: Text, image and video creation toolbars now share a consistent layout.

fixes.zh: 修复部分图片生成比例不准确的问题。
fixes.en: Fixed inaccurate aspect ratios in some image generations.

fixes.zh: 切换节点时分别保留提示词和参数草稿。
fixes.en: Prompt and parameter drafts are retained separately when switching nodes.

fixes.zh: 生成失败或结果待确认时保留状态卡片，避免进度突然消失。
fixes.en: Status cards remain visible when generation fails or results need confirmation.

improvements.zh: 新增本机3D产品工作台，支持瓶罐盒参数化建模、材质灯光调整与工程导出。
improvements.en: Added a local 3D product workbench with bottle, jar and box modeling, materials, lighting and project export.

improvements.zh: 支持浏览器内瓶体照片近似建模、标准盒展开折叠预览与整圈标签。
improvements.en: Added approximate bottle modeling from photos in the browser, standard carton folding previews and wraparound labels.

improvements.zh: 统一画布图标，改善创作助手的文字实时显示与操作反馈。
improvements.en: Unified canvas icons and improved live assistant text and interaction feedback.

fixes.zh: 作品详情只展示实际保存的提示词，缺失时不再填入示例内容。
fixes.en: Artwork details display saved prompts only, without demo fallback text.

fixes.zh: 编辑图片时按明确参考角色决定自动画幅，并移除重复的创作面板。
fixes.en: Automatic image framing follows explicit reference roles, and duplicate creation controls were removed.

improvements.zh: 新增包装策略创作页，可补充需求、追问、调整并保存方案。
improvements.en: Create packaging strategies with guided questions, revisions and saved projects.

improvements.zh: 支持拖拽或点击导入创作技能文件。
improvements.en: Import creative skill files by dragging or clicking.

improvements.zh: 画布可批量运行选中节点，并显示生成进度。
improvements.en: Run selected canvas nodes in batches and see generation progress.

improvements.zh: 视频节点支持选中后直接编辑提示词、参数与引用。
improvements.en: Edit video prompts, settings and references directly from selected nodes.

fixes.zh: 保留手动调整的画布位置，减少生成结果相互遮挡。
fixes.en: Preserve manual canvas positions and reduce overlapping results.

fixes.zh: 改善图片完整展示和切回页面时的加载体验。
fixes.en: Improve full-image presentation and image retention when returning to the page.
